title: Puthoff visited Ossining and heard about the Nine

tellings.quote: Puthoff tells us that he went to Puharich's house in Ossining, heard all about the nine,

plain: Sometime in the 1970s, the researcher Hal Puthoff went to the scientist Andrija Puharich's house in Ossining, New York, and "heard all about the Nine", the alien council Puharich's circle said it was in contact with. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells this as something Puthoff told him and his colleagues, and he also mentions Puthoff's colleague Russell Targ. If true, it would mean serious researchers heard about the Nine contacts firsthand.
